Desi Turkish Eggs
fusion breakfast recipe | 30 minute recipe | lazy girl breakfast | high protein 

Nutrition: 
Macros: C: 10 | F: 22 | P: 21
Calories:  353 per serve without bread
Makes 1 serving

Ingredients 

yogurt base: 
100 grams greek yogurt 
1 tsp minced garlic 
1/2 green chili, finely chopped
chopped coriander
pinch of salt 

tadka:
7 grams butter + 1 tsp oil
1 tsp mustard seeds
2 dried red chilli
pinch of red chilli powder
1 sprig curry leaves
pinch of hing, optional 
a pinch of turmeric

2 softboiled egg

garnish: 
coriander 
 
Method
start by boiling the water for the eggs, perfect softboiled egg 101 is mentioned in the notes below 

combine yogurt, garlic, coriander and salt in a bowl, set aside

for the tadka, add butter + oil to a pan then add in the mustard seeds and let them pop then add in the rest of the ingredients stir for a few seconds then take off the heat 

to plate, add the yogurt mix to the base of the plate then add the soft boiled egg and top with the tadka 
enjoy with some buttered pav or malabar paratha
